prior_importants.description: `closeSync(taken.statusFd)` runs outside `release()`'s try/finally, so a close error skips the lock release, leaves the stayAlive signal listeners installed, and replaces `fn`'s outcome, against withMergeLock's "A release error never replaces what `fn` did".

findings.description: This test file covers `progress.utils.ts` but is named `progress.test.ts`. Its `src/core` siblings name a utils file's test `<subject>-utils.test.ts`, for example `paths-utils.test.ts`, `glob-utils.test.ts` and `gate-env-utils.test.ts`. Anyone who looks for a source file's test by that pattern searches for `progress-utils.test.ts` and finds nothing. Renaming it to `progress-utils.test.ts` would fix that.

process_issues.description: The docs reviewer read only the ADR, src/core/progress.utils.ts and the lock-status code in src/core/merge-gate.service.ts. It did not check the prose in src/cli/index.ts, the other src/core/*.service.ts files or the test comments.
I did not spawn the consolidator: the reviewers returned a single finding, so there was nothing to group.
